title: Lantern Circuit
creation_method: Independent deterministic B–G# minor–E–F# Synthwave game movement and new C# minor–A–E–B answer movement for a 128-second stream master; generated oscillators and seeded noise only, no sampled source audio or repeated first-minute loop; -2 dB linear gain before AAC encoding

art_provenance.cover_prompt: Edit Image 1 into a NEW original SQUARE 1:1 cover-art candidate for duohertz track Lantern Circuit. Image 1 is CONTENT reference only: preserve the recognizable idea of several hanging lantern-shaped signal nodes joined by a single continuous circuit line and one clearly dominant central lantern. Completely remove its mauve fantasy sky, real-looking lantern glass, 3D glow, reflective water, tiny lights and haze. Image 2 is STYLE reference only for near-black ink, warm-ivory paper cutouts, coral and electric-cyan accents, bold halftone print texture, angular high-contrast editorial rhythm-game design. Do not copy Image 2's interlocking circular rings or radial layout. Compose five large flattened geometric lantern icons in a zigzag arrangement: the central lantern largest and warm yellow, two coral and two warm ivory, all joined by ONE angular electric-cyan cable that visibly enters and exits each lantern. Give each lantern a unique horizontal frequency-bar cutout. Use a few crisp diagonal coral paper wedges and sparse halftone, with an uncluttered dark lower fifth for a later local title overlay. At 100px the five linked lights and central leader must remain clear. All ages, energetic, no strobe. No sky, landscape, water, photorealistic lanterns, rings, trees, platforms, character, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark or copied game art.
